test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Consider the following statements about the 6th ASEAN–India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) Joint Committee:****1) All 10 ASEAN countries participated, and all 8 Sub-Committees met physically in New Delhi.
2) The review was preceded by high-level meetings in Laos urging completion by 2025.
3) ASEAN became India’s largest trading partner with USD 121 billion in 2023–24.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?**
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 only**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• The **6th meeting** of the **ASEAN–India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) Joint Committee** was held in **New Delhi** from July 29 to August 1, 2024. While delegates from all 10 **ASEAN countries** participated, the sub-committees conducted their discussions in a **hybrid mode**, meaning not all meetings were exclusively physical. Thus, Statement 1 is incorrect.

• The review process of **AITIGA** is a priority for both India and ASEAN. High-level discussions, including the **ASEAN-India Economic Ministers’ meeting** held in **Vientiane, Laos**, have consistently urged the **Joint Committee** to conclude the review by **2025** to modernize the agreement. Thus, Statement 2 is correct.

• While **ASEAN** is a vital trading partner for India, it is not the largest. In the 2023–24 fiscal year, the **United States (USA)** remained India’s largest trading partner, followed by **China** and the **UAE**. India’s trade with ASEAN stood at approximately **USD 120.97 billion**, accounting for about 11% of India’s total global trade, but it does not hold the top spot. Thus, Statement 3 is incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **ASEAN–India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA)** was originally signed in **2009** and came into effect in **2010**.

• The primary objective of the current review is to address the **trade deficit** India faces with ASEAN and to incorporate modern trade elements like **Rules of Origin**, **Trade Remedies**, and **Technical Barriers to Trade**.

• The **8 Sub-Committees** established under the Joint Committee deal with specific areas such as **Customs Procedures**, **Sanitary and Phytosanitary measures**, and **Legal and Institutional issues**.

• The 10 **ASEAN** member states are **Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam**.
